events.text: Frederick Ralph Sharp was born.
events.subject: self
events.quote: December 8 , 1915 – June 10 , 1992

events.text: Frederick Ralph Sharp died.
events.subject: self
events.quote: December 8 , 1915 – June 10 , 1992

events.text: Sharp was born in Moosomin, Saskatchewan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Sharp was born in Moosomin , Saskatchewan in 1915

events.text: Sharp graduated from the Royal Military College of Canada.
events.subject: self
events.quote: graduated from the Royal Military College of Canada in 1938

events.text: Sharp attended the War Staff College.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He attended the War Staff College in 1944

events.text: Sharp joined the Royal Canadian Air Force in Trenton, Ontario.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he joined the Royal Canadian Air Force in Trenton , Ontario in July 1939

events.text: Sharp earned his wings as a pilot in Trenton.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He earned his wings as a pilot in Trenton in 1939

events.text: Sharp completed the flying instructor course at Camp Borden.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He completed the flying instructor course at Camp Borden in 1939

events.text: Sharp was posted overseas as C.O. of No. 408 Bomber Squadron, 6 Bomber Group.
events.subject: self
events.quote: before being posted overseas as C.O . of No . 408 Bomber Squadron , 6 Bomber Group 26 November 1944

events.text: Sharp won a Distinguished Flying Cross (DFC) with No. 408 Goose Squadron.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He won a Distinguished Flying Cross ( DFC ) on 4 May 1945 with No . 408 Goose Squadron

events.text: Sharp was a member of the Chelsey committee.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1946 , he was a member of the Chelsey committee

events.text: Sharp became the commander of the RCAF Training Command and various posting with NORAD.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1959 , he became the commander of the RCAF Training Command and various posting with NORAD

events.text: Sharp served as Vice Chief of Defence Staff.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He served as Vice Chief of Defence Staff from 1966

events.text: Sharp was regraded from Air Marshal to Lieutenant General.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1968 , he was regraded from Air Marshal to Lieutenant General

events.text: Sharp was appointed Deputy Commander-in-Chief of NORAD.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in January 1969 he was appointed Deputy Commander-in-Chief of NORAD

events.text: Sharp was elevated to the rank of General.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1969 , Sharp was elevated to the rank of General

events.text: Sharp served as Chief of Defence Staff of the Canadian Armed Forces.
events.subject: self
events.quote: served as Chief of Defence Staff of the Canadian Armed Forces from 1969 to 1972

events.text: Sharp's service as Chief of Defence Staff ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: served as Chief of Defence Staff of the Canadian Armed Forces from 1969 to 1972

events.text: Sharp retired.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He retired in 1972

events.text: Sharp became a partner in a consulting firm.
events.subject: self
events.quote: became a partner in a consulting firm until 1979

events.text: Sharp's partnership in a consulting firm ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: became a partner in a consulting firm until 1979

events.text: Sharp joined Ross Campbell as a founding partner in InterCon Consultants.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1983 he joined retired Canadian Ambassador Ross Campbell , as a founding partner in the consulting company InterCon Consultants

events.text: Sharp wrote a paper for the Air University Review on the Reorganization of the Canadian Armed Forces.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He wrote a paper for the July–August 1967 Air University Review on the Reorganization of the Canadian Armed Forces
